question: How does John describe Jesus in the opening verse?
explanation: John begins by identifying Jesus as the eternal Word.

question: What did John the Baptist call Jesus?
explanation: John the Baptist pointed to Jesus as the Lamb of God.

question: Who brought Simon to Jesus?
explanation: Andrew found his brother Simon and brought him to Jesus.

question: What new name did Jesus give Simon?
explanation: Jesus said Simon would be called Cephas, which means a stone.

question: Who asked, 'Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth?'
explanation: Nathanael said this before meeting Jesus.

question: At what event did Jesus perform His first miracle in John?
explanation: Jesus' first sign in John took place at a wedding in Cana.

question: What did Jesus turn into wine?
explanation: Jesus changed water into wine.

question: What did Jesus show by His first miracle at Cana?
explanation: John says Jesus manifested forth His glory.

question: Whom did Jesus drive out of the temple?
choices: Those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves
explanation: Jesus cleansed the temple of commercial corruption.

question: What temple was Jesus speaking about when He said, 'Destroy this temple'?
explanation: John explains that Jesus was speaking of the temple of His body.

question: Who came to Jesus by night?
explanation: Nicodemus came by night to speak with Jesus.

question: What did Jesus say a man must be to see the kingdom of God?
explanation: Jesus said a man must be born again.

question: What Old Testament event did Jesus compare to His being lifted up?
explanation: Jesus compared His lifting up to the serpent in the wilderness.

question: Why did God give His only begotten Son?
explanation: God's gift of His Son is grounded in His love for the world.

question: Who said, 'He must increase, but I must decrease'?
explanation: John the Baptist gladly pointed away from himself and toward Christ.

question: At what well did Jesus speak with the Samaritan woman?
explanation: Jesus sat by Jacob's well in Samaria.

question: What kind of water did Jesus offer the woman?
explanation: Jesus spoke of living water that satisfies forever.

question: How many husbands had the Samaritan woman had?
explanation: Jesus told her she had had five husbands.

question: What did the woman say she knew Messiah would do when He came?
explanation: She said Messiah would tell them all things.

question: Whom did Jesus heal at the end of the chapter?
explanation: Jesus healed the nobleman's son from a distance.

question: How long had the man at the pool been infirm?
explanation: The man had suffered his infirmity for thirty-eight years.

question: What did Jesus tell the man at the pool to do?
choices: Rise, take up thy bed, and walk
explanation: Jesus told him to rise, take up his bed, and walk, and immediately the man was made whole.

question: On what day did Jesus heal the man at the pool?
explanation: The healing happened on the Sabbath, and the Jews objected to the man carrying his bed.

question: What did Jesus say the Father had given Him authority to do?
explanation: The Father gave the Son authority to execute judgment.

question: Whose writings did Jesus say testified of Him?
explanation: Jesus said Moses wrote of Him.

question: How many loaves were used to feed the five thousand?
explanation: A boy had five barley loaves and two small fishes.

question: How many baskets of fragments were gathered after the feeding?
explanation: Twelve baskets of fragments remained.

question: What miracle happened when the disciples were on the sea?
explanation: Jesus came to them walking on the sea.

question: What did Jesus call Himself in this chapter?
explanation: Jesus said, 'I am the bread of life.'

question: After Jesus taught about eating His flesh and drinking His blood, what did many of His disciples do?
choices: They went back and walked no more with Him
explanation: Many called it a hard saying, went back, and walked no more with Him.

question: At what feast did Jesus go up to Jerusalem?
explanation: John identifies it as the Jews' feast of tabernacles.

question: How did Jesus go to the feast at first?
explanation: Jesus went up privately rather than openly at first.

question: What did Jesus cry on the last day of the feast?
choices: Come unto me, and I will judge
If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink
explanation: Jesus invited the thirsty to come to Him and drink.

question: What did Jesus say would flow from the belly of the one who believes on Him?
explanation: Jesus described the Spirit with the image of living water.

question: What did the officers sent to arrest Jesus say when they returned empty-handed?
choices: Never man spake like this man
We lost Him in the city
explanation: They were struck by Jesus' words.

question: What did Jesus say to the woman taken in adultery after her accusers left?
explanation: Jesus showed mercy while calling her to leave sin.

question: What title did Jesus use for Himself?
explanation: Jesus said He is the light of the world.

question: According to Jesus, who would know the truth and be made free?
choices: Those who continue in His word
explanation: Jesus tied freedom to abiding in His word.

question: How did Jesus finish the statement that begins 'Before Abraham was'?
explanation: Jesus used the divine name 'I am.'

question: How did the crowd respond when Jesus said He was before Abraham?
explanation: They took up stones to cast at Him, but Jesus hid Himself and went out of the temple.

question: What condition did the man in this chapter have from birth?
explanation: Jesus met a man who had been blind from birth.

question: What did Jesus use along with saliva in the healing?
explanation: Jesus made clay and anointed the man's eyes.

question: Where did Jesus tell the man to wash?
explanation: The man washed in Siloam and came back seeing.

question: What did the healed man answer when asked who Jesus was?
explanation: The healed man said Jesus was a prophet.

question: What did Jesus say of Himself again in this chapter?
choices: I am the light of the world
explanation: Jesus repeated that He is the light of the world.

question: What did Jesus call Himself?
explanation: Jesus said, 'I am the good shepherd.'

question: What does the good shepherd do for the sheep?
choices: Gives his life for the sheep
explanation: The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.

question: What do the sheep know?
explanation: The sheep know their shepherd's voice.

question: What did Jesus say no man would do to His sheep?
choices: Pluck them out of His hand
explanation: Jesus promised security for His sheep.

question: What statement caused the Jews to take up stones again?
choices: I am the bread of life
I and my Father are one
The truth shall make you free
explanation: They reacted strongly when Jesus declared His unity with the Father.

question: Who was sick in Bethany?
explanation: Lazarus of Bethany was sick.

question: What did Jesus say He is?
explanation: Jesus declared Himself the resurrection and the life.

question: What is the shortest verse in the chapter and the Bible?
explanation: John simply says, 'Jesus wept.'

question: What did Jesus cry with a loud voice at the tomb?
explanation: Jesus called Lazarus out of the tomb.

question: What did Caiaphas say was expedient?
choices: That one man should die for the people
explanation: Caiaphas argued it was expedient for one man to die for the people.

question: Who anointed Jesus' feet with ointment and wiped them with her hair?
explanation: Mary anointed Jesus' feet with costly ointment.

question: Who objected to the cost of the ointment?
explanation: Judas complained about the ointment's value.

question: What did the crowd carry when Jesus entered Jerusalem?
explanation: They took branches of palm trees to meet Him.

question: What heavenly response came when Jesus prayed, 'Father, glorify thy name'?
explanation: A voice answered from heaven.

question: When Jesus said, 'And I, if I be lifted up from the earth,' what was He signifying?
explanation: John explains Jesus was signifying the manner of His death.

question: What humble act did Jesus perform for His disciples?
explanation: Jesus washed the disciples' feet.

question: Who at first refused to let Jesus wash his feet?
explanation: Peter resisted until Jesus explained its importance.

question: Who did Jesus say would betray Him?
choices: The one to whom He gave the sop
The one who sat nearest the door
explanation: Jesus identified the betrayer by giving him the sop.

question: What new commandment did Jesus give?
explanation: Jesus commanded His disciples to love one another as He loved them.

question: How many times did Jesus say Peter would deny Him before the rooster crowed?
explanation: Jesus foretold Peter's three denials.

question: What did Jesus say was in His Father's house?
explanation: Jesus said in His Father's house are many mansions.

question: Who asked, 'How can we know the way?'
explanation: Thomas voiced the disciples' confusion.

question: What did Jesus say He is?
choices: The way, the truth, and the life
explanation: Jesus said no one comes to the Father but by Him.

question: Whom did Jesus promise the Father would send as Comforter?
explanation: Jesus promised the Holy Ghost as the Comforter.

question: What did Jesus leave with His disciples?
explanation: Jesus said, 'Peace I leave with you.'

question: What did Jesus call Himself?
explanation: Jesus said, 'I am the true vine.'

question: Who did Jesus say is the husbandman?
explanation: The Father is the husbandman of the vine.

question: What must branches do to bear fruit?
explanation: Fruit comes from abiding in Christ.

question: What did Jesus call His disciples?
explanation: Jesus called them friends because He had made known the Father's things to them.

question: What new standard of love did Jesus set?
choices: Love one another as I have loved you
explanation: Jesus grounded love in His own example.

question: Why did Jesus say He told these things beforehand?
choices: So they could teach the rulers
So they should not be offended
explanation: Jesus spoke ahead of time to keep them from stumbling.

question: Whom did Jesus say He would send after departing?
explanation: Jesus said He would send the Comforter.

question: Of what would the Spirit convict the world?
explanation: Jesus described the Spirit's convicting ministry.

question: What did Jesus say the disciples' sorrow would become?
explanation: Their sorrow would be turned into joy.

question: What did Jesus say about the world at the end of the chapter?
explanation: Jesus declared His victory over the world.

question: What did Jesus ask the Father to do in the opening of this prayer?
explanation: Jesus asked the Father to glorify the Son.

question: How did Jesus define eternal life?
choices: Knowing the one true God and Jesus Christ
explanation: Jesus defined eternal life relationally.

question: What did Jesus pray concerning His disciples in the world?
explanation: Jesus prayed for their protection from evil.

question: Through what did Jesus ask the Father to sanctify His disciples?
explanation: Jesus prayed, 'Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.'

question: For whom else did Jesus pray beyond the apostles?
choices: Those who would believe through their word
explanation: Jesus prayed for future believers too.

question: Where did Jesus go with His disciples before His arrest?
choices: A garden across the brook Cedron
explanation: Jesus went into a garden with His disciples.

question: Who led the band and officers to arrest Jesus?
explanation: Judas came guiding those who came to arrest Jesus.

question: What happened when Jesus said, 'I am he'?
choices: They went backward and fell to the ground
explanation: The arresting party fell back when Jesus identified Himself.

question: Whose ear did Peter cut off?
explanation: Peter struck Malchus, the high priest's servant.

question: How did Jesus answer Pilate when asked if He was a king?
choices: My kingdom is not of this world
explanation: Jesus said His kingdom is not of this world.

question: What did the soldiers place on Jesus' head?
explanation: The soldiers plaited a crown of thorns.

question: What title did Pilate write and place on the cross?
choices: Jesus of Nazareth the King of the Jews
explanation: Pilate wrote, 'Jesus of Nazareth the King of the Jews.'

question: What did Jesus say from the cross to His mother?
explanation: Jesus said to His mother, 'Woman, behold thy son!' and to the disciple, 'Behold thy mother!'

question: What did Jesus declare just before bowing His head?
explanation: Jesus declared the work finished.

question: Who brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes for Jesus' burial?
explanation: Nicodemus came with myrrh and aloes.

question: Who came early to the sepulchre while it was yet dark?
explanation: Mary Magdalene came early to the tomb.

question: Who ran together to the sepulchre after hearing Mary's report?
explanation: Peter and the other disciple ran to the tomb.

question: What did Jesus say to Mary when she recognized Him?
explanation: Jesus told Mary not to cling to Him.

question: What did Thomas say he needed in order to believe?
choices: To see and touch the wounds
explanation: Thomas said he needed to see and touch the wounds.

question: Whom did Jesus call blessed when He spoke to Thomas?
choices: Those who have not seen, and yet have believed
Those who were in the room
explanation: Jesus said, 'Blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.'

question: At what sea did Jesus show Himself again to the disciples?
explanation: John says Jesus showed Himself again at the sea of Tiberias.

question: What happened when the disciples obeyed Jesus and cast the net on the right side?
choices: They caught a great multitude of fishes
explanation: They enclosed a great number of fishes.

question: What question did Jesus ask Peter three times?
explanation: Jesus asked Peter three times, 'Lovest thou me?'

question: What charge did Jesus give Peter after Peter said he loved Him?
explanation: Jesus charged Peter to care for His flock.

question: What simple command did Jesus give Peter after speaking of his future?
explanation: Jesus ended by telling Peter, 'Follow me.'

question: What does the husbandman do with every branch that bears no fruit?
explanation: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away.

question: What did Jesus say the disciples can do without Him?
explanation: For without me ye can do nothing.

question: In the picture Jesus gives, what are the disciples?
explanation: I am the vine, ye are the branches.

question: What happens to a man who does not abide in Jesus?
choices: He is pruned and tried again
He is grafted into another vine
He is cast forth like a withered branch and burned
explanation: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

question: What did Jesus say would glorify His Father?
choices: That the disciples bear much fruit
explanation: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

question: What did Jesus say is the greatest love a man can have?
choices: To give all his goods away
To lay down his life for his friends
explanation: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

question: Whom did Jesus say the world hated before it hated the disciples?
explanation: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.

question: Who chose whom, according to Jesus?
choices: He chose them, not they Him
explanation: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you.

question: What is the Comforter called whom Jesus will send from the Father?
explanation: The Comforter, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth.

question: What happens to the branch that does bear fruit?
choices: The husbandman purges it so it bears more fruit
It is moved to another vine
explanation: Every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

question: What did Jesus promise if they abide in Him and His words abide in them?
choices: They shall ask what they will and receive it
They will see the kingdom at once
explanation: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

question: How does Jesus compare His love for the disciples?
choices: As a father loves a prodigal
As the Father has loved Him
explanation: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

question: How did Jesus say the disciples would abide in His love?
explanation: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love.

question: Why did Jesus say He had spoken these things to them?
choices: That His joy might remain in them and their joy be full
explanation: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

question: What does the servant not know that the friend knows?
explanation: The servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends.

question: For what did Jesus say He ordained the disciples?
choices: To go and bring forth fruit that should remain
explanation: I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain.

question: What did Jesus say the world would do if the disciples were of the world?
explanation: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own.

question: What did Jesus remind them of about a servant and his lord?
choices: The servant may become the lord
The servant is not greater than his lord
explanation: The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you.

question: Why would they do these things to the disciples?
choices: For His name's sake; they know not Him that sent Him
explanation: All these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.

question: What did Jesus say hating Him meant?
explanation: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

question: What will the Comforter do when He comes?
explanation: He shall testify of me.

question: Why did Jesus say the disciples would also bear witness?
choices: Because they had been with Him from the beginning
explanation: Ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

question: What does the one who abides in Jesus, and Jesus in him, bring forth?
explanation: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit.

question: Whose commandments did Jesus say He had kept?
explanation: Even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.

question: On what condition did Jesus say the disciples are His friends?
choices: If they pay the temple tax
If they do whatsoever He commands
explanation: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

question: Why did Jesus say He called them friends and not servants?
choices: He had made known to them all He heard of the Father
explanation: I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

question: What did Jesus say the people had seen, and hated both Him and His Father anyway?
choices: Works which none other man did
explanation: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

question: What was written in their law, according to Jesus, about how they hated Him?
choices: They hated Him without a cause
explanation: That the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

question: Who gather the withered branches and cast them into the fire?
explanation: Men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

question: In whose name did Jesus say whatever they ask of the Father would be given?
choices: In the name of the law
In the name of the temple
explanation: Whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

question: What did Jesus say about those who kept His saying?
choices: They will keep the disciples' saying also
explanation: If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

question: From whom did Jesus say the Spirit of truth proceeds?
explanation: The Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me.

question: Besides themselves abiding in Jesus, what did He say must abide in them?
explanation: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

question: What did Jesus say the branch cannot do of itself?
choices: Bear fruit unless it abides in the vine
explanation: As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

question: Through what did Jesus say the disciples were already clean?
choices: The word He had spoken to them
explanation: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.

question: Why did Jesus say the world hates the disciples?
choices: They are not of the world, but He chose them out of it
explanation: Because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

question: What did Jesus say the unbelievers now had no cloke for?
explanation: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.

question: Where did Jesus say His followers would be put out of?
explanation: They shall put you out of the synagogues.

question: What fills the disciples' hearts because Jesus said He was leaving?
explanation: Because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

question: What did Jesus say was expedient, or good, for the disciples?
explanation: It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you.

question: What did Jesus say the Spirit of truth would do for the disciples?
explanation: When he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth.

question: What picture of sorrow turning to joy did Jesus use?
explanation: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish.

question: Whom did Jesus say would still be with Him when the disciples left Him alone?
explanation: Ye shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

question: To whom did Jesus say He was going, though none asked where?
explanation: Now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

question: What did Jesus say the disciples would have in Him?
explanation: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace.

question: What did Jesus say the disciples would have in the world?
explanation: In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

question: What did the disciples say made them believe Jesus came from God?
explanation: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

question: Why would they do these things to the disciples?
choices: Because the disciples broke the law
Because they have not known the Father nor Jesus
explanation: These things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

question: Why had Jesus not said these things at the beginning?
choices: Because the time was not set
explanation: These things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

question: What did Jesus say none of the disciples asked Him?
explanation: Now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

question: What did Jesus say would happen to the Comforter if He did not go away?
explanation: If I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

question: Of sin, the Spirit reproves the world because of what?
explanation: He will reprove the world of sin... Of sin, because they believe not on me.

question: Of righteousness, the Spirit reproves the world because of what?
choices: Jesus goes to the Father and they see Him no more
explanation: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more.

question: Of judgment, the Spirit reproves the world because of what?
choices: The prince of this world is judged
explanation: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

question: Whom did Jesus say the Spirit would glorify?
explanation: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

question: What did Jesus say the Spirit would show the disciples?
explanation: He will shew you things to come.

question: What saying did the disciples say they could not understand?
choices: A little while, and ye shall not see me
I am the bread of life
explanation: What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.

question: What did Jesus say the world would do while the disciples wept and lamented?
explanation: Ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice.

question: What did Jesus say no man would take from the disciples?
explanation: I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

question: In whose name had the disciples asked nothing until then?
choices: In the name of the Spirit
explanation: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

question: How had Jesus been speaking to them until then?
explanation: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

question: Why did Jesus say the Father Himself loves the disciples?
choices: Because they gave up their nets
Because they loved Jesus and believed He came from God
explanation: The Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

question: What did Jesus say whosoever killed His followers would think?
explanation: Whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

question: Why did Jesus say He told them these things beforehand?
choices: So they would remember that He told them when the time came
explanation: These things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them.

question: Whose words did Jesus say the Spirit of truth would speak?
choices: Whatsoever He hears, not of Himself
explanation: He shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak.

question: What did Jesus say about all that the Father has?
explanation: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

question: What did Jesus say about the many things He still had to say?
choices: They were not to be spoken
They could not bear them yet
explanation: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

question: What did Jesus know about the disciples as they wondered among themselves?
choices: That they were desirous to ask Him
explanation: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him.

question: Why does the woman in travail have sorrow?
explanation: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come.

question: Why does she remember no more the anguish?
choices: For joy that a man is born into the world
explanation: For joy that a man is born into the world.

question: What did Jesus say He would not do for them at that day?
explanation: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you.

question: What did Jesus say the disciples would ask Him in that day?
explanation: In that day ye shall ask me nothing.

question: What did Jesus answer when His disciples said they now believed?
explanation: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

question: What did the disciples say Jesus needed not?
choices: That any man should ask Him
explanation: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee.

question: What did Jesus say the disciples would do in another little while?
explanation: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.

question: From whom did Jesus say He had come forth into the world?
explanation: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world.

question: What did Jesus say would make the disciples' joy full?
choices: Asking in His name and receiving
explanation: Ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

question: Where did Jesus lift up His eyes as He began to pray?
explanation: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come.

question: What did Jesus say He had finished?
choices: The work the Father gave Him to do
explanation: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

question: For whom did Jesus say He was not praying?
explanation: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou gavest me.

question: What did Jesus ask the Father to keep the disciples through, so they may be one?
explanation: Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

question: Which of those given to Jesus was lost?
explanation: None of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

question: What did Jesus say about the disciples and the world?
choices: They are lords of the world
They are not of the world
explanation: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

question: What did Jesus ask for all who believe through the disciples' word?
choices: That they all may be one
explanation: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee.

question: Of whom did Jesus say the world had not known?
explanation: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee.

question: What glory did Jesus ask the Father to give Him?
choices: The glory He had with the Father before the world was
explanation: Glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

question: What had Jesus given the disciples?
choices: The words the Father gave Him
explanation: I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them.

question: Why did Jesus pray for those He was praying for?
explanation: I pray for them... which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

question: In whose name had Jesus kept the disciples while He was with them?
explanation: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name.

question: Why did Jesus speak these things in the world?
choices: That they might have His joy fulfilled in themselves
That they might know the law
explanation: These things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

question: What had Jesus given the disciples, and the world hated them for it?
explanation: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world.

question: What did Jesus say He had done with the disciples, as the Father had done with Him?
explanation: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.

explanation: He girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

question: What did Jesus say Peter did when he was young?

question: What did the other disciples do with the net in the little ship?
